trees.name: Outskirts_Trees_023
trees.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit.
Asset type: production transparent PNG tree sprite for an existing top-down fantasy Godot map.
Edit target: the attached original Outskirts_Trees_023.png.
Clean this EXACT tree into a genuinely reusable, sharply cut transparent sprite. Retain its existing leaf clusters, overall round crown silhouette, muted olive-green palette, pixel-art texture, trunk, roots, viewing angle and light direction. Do not invent a different tree.
Remove EVERY non-tree artifact: all stray grass/earth pixels, tan dirt smudges attached to the outer leaves, rectangular or angular extraction remnants, neighboring foliage scraps, halos, and any ground shadow or dark oval beneath/around the roots. The only opaque pixels should be the actual tree itself: leaves, branches, trunk and roots. Inner canopy shading is part of the tree and should stay.
Finish each outer leaf contour cleanly with no dirt-colored fringe, no green background mat, no blurry feathering. No cast ground shadow at all. No grass tufts or flowers. No extra objects, no checkerboard baked into the picture. Output real transparent alpha, with the entire tree comfortably inside the canvas, no clipping. Preserve the familiar small-pixel, hand-crafted look; avoid smooth painterly reinterpretation. Remove the disconnected leaf strip across the top and finish the main tree crown cleanly.

ground.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent ground-only terrain atlas from an existing fantasy Godot map.
Edit target: attached ground-north-input.png.
Remove all baked tree shadows and extracted-tree remnants from the GRASS. The picture is a ground layer with ghost silhouettes where trees were removed: dark crown-shaped rings, leaf contour fragments, brown trunk smudges, repeated mirrored dark canopy shapes, and pasted grass patches. Repaint ONLY those residual tree/shadow areas as clean, coherent, naturally varied fine pixel-art grass, matching the ORIGINAL surrounding grass's exact muted yellow-green/olive palette, scale, blade density and sharpness. Make the grass feel like continuous intact native game art with no tree-shaped darkening or circular patch edges.
Keep the overall terrain layout, all existing paths/dirt/cobble/shore stones/bank edges, exact opaque ground outline and transparent holes unchanged. Do not add any trees, bushes, props, animals, flowers, roots, tree-shaped shadows, dark ovals, radial circles, ornamental patches, blurred textures, oversized grass blades, checkerboards or new objects. Preserve alpha transparency for all currently empty spaces. The result must be a ground-only layer with no trees or ground shadows.
